name: Plate XXX: The Taijitu and the Eight Trigrams
description: Yin and Yang turning within one another, ringed by the Earlier Heaven arrangement of Fu Xi's eight trigrams. Struck in Vermilion: cinnabar, the red sulphide of mercury. Degree of Adept, rank 51 of the folio. “ORA LEGE LEGE LEGE RELEGE LABORA ET INVENIES”: Pray, read, read, read, reread, work, and you will find (Mutus Liber).
